name: Souggvuez
description: Souggvuez society is organised around four distinct castes — Designer, Explorer, Hunter, and Worker — each shaped by specialised roles and carrying different characteristic modifiers. All Souggvuez share a tough hide granting natural protection and a powerful bite. Their base characteristics are somewhat more agile and educated than typical humans, though less intellectually inclined.

caste_options.label: Designer
caste_options.description: Creative and precise caste. DEX+2, END-1, INT-1, EDU+1. Artists, architects, and craftspeople.

caste_options.label: Explorer
caste_options.description: Field-work and reconnaissance caste. DEX+2, END-1, INT-2, EDU+2. Scouts, mappers, and field agents.

caste_options.label: Hunter
caste_options.description: Combat and tracking caste. DEX+2, INT-2, EDU+1. Warriors, trackers, and bodyguards.

caste_options.label: Worker
caste_options.description: Practical and industrious caste. DEX+1, INT-2, EDU+2. Labourers, technicians, and tradespeople.

species_notes: Select a caste to see full characteristic modifiers.
All Souggvuez share: Natural Armour Protection +1, Bite (Melee natural, 1D+2).
All careers from the Traveller Core Rulebook are suitable for Souggvuez.
source: Aliens of Charted Space, Mongoose Publishing
